user.title: Dyson Spot+Scrub AI
user.description: **Privacy notice:** This integration connects to Dyson's cloud API to control your robot and access map data. Your account credentials or bearer token are stored in Home Assistant and should be kept out of version control or shared config files — treat them like a password.

menu_options.login: Log in with Dyson account (email + OTP)

login.title: Dyson Account Login
login.description: Enter your Dyson account credentials. An OTP code will be emailed to you if your account requires it.

otp.title: One-Time Passcode
otp.description: A 6-digit code was sent to **{email}**. Enter it below.

token.title: Dyson Spot+Scrub AI
token.description: Enter a Dyson bearer token (captured via a proxy tool such as Proxyman, or copied from another integration), your robot's serial number, and your Dyson account country code.

select_robot.title: Select Robot
select_robot.description: Multiple robots found. Choose one to add.

abort.no_robots_found: No robot vacuums were found in your Dyson account.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Dyson's cloud API.
abort.invalid_serial: The device reported an invalid serial number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Dyson's servers. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials.
error.invalid_otp: Dyson rejected the code or password. Check both (you can correct the password below without requesting a new code) and try once more. If it is rejected again, stop: Dyson gives the same answer for a locked account, and repeated attempts can extend a lock.
error.serial_not_found: That serial number was not found in your Dyson account.
error.invalid_serial: The serial number contains invalid characters. Use letters, digits and hyphens only.
error.invalid_country: Enter a two-letter country code, e.g. GB or AU.
error.rate_limited: Dyson is limiting login attempts for this account. Wait a while before trying again rather than retrying straight away.
error.account_not_active: Dyson reports this account is not active, so no login code was requested. Check the account in the MyDyson app.
error.unsupported_auth_method: This Dyson account uses a sign-in method the integration doesn't support yet. No login code was requested; use a bearer token instead.
error.app_version_unsupported: Dyson now requires a newer MyDyson app version than this integration reports. No login code was requested; the integration needs updating.
error.too_many_attempts: Login is paused for 15 minutes after two rejected attempts, to protect your Dyson account. If attempts keep being rejected with the right code and password, Dyson may have locked the account: stop and wait several hours, or contact Dyson support, rather than retrying.

start_rooms_with_settings.description: Apply a room-settings draft and send selected room IDs to the robot in the supplied order. The robot may choose its own execution order.

room_settings.name: Room settings

init.title: Map settings
init.description: Changes apply on the next camera refresh, including while the last cleaning map is retained.

data_description.map_retention_minutes: Time after cleaning finishes or is cancelled. Set to 0 to disable timed retention. Pauses and transitions between vacuuming and mopping keep the map without starting this timer.
data_description.map_keep_last: Keep the last cleaning map until a new cleaning starts, the map changes, or the integration restarts. Overrides retention time. When switched off, time is counted from the original end of cleaning.
data_description.map_transparent_background: Remove the map background for use over a floorplan.

data_description.map_combined_color: Used for simultaneous vacuuming and mopping. Sequential cleaning keeps separate vacuum and mop colors.
data_description.map_path_width: Line width in source-image pixels. Dashboard scaling affects its displayed size.
data_description.map_glow_width: Total width of the translucent line behind the cleaning path. Set a value greater than Path width for a visible glow. Set 0 to disable.

visibility_settings_section.name: Visible elements
visibility_settings_section.description: Enabled elements are visible. Hidden elements still contribute to image bounds, preserving the overlay alignment.

data_description.map_show_status_areas: Colored room fills indicating cleaning progress.
data_description.map_show_perimeter: Room-edge segments from the Dyson map. These are separate from the live cleaning path.
data_description.map_show_visited_paths: Additional room tracks provided by Dyson. These may also trace room boundaries.
data_description.map_show_grid: Includes distance labels and the map origin marker.
data_description.map_show_waypoints: Dots along the cleaning path. The robot position remains visible.
data_description.map_show_legend: The legend has its own room labels, independent of Show room names.

error.invalid_map_option: Enter a valid value within the allowed range.
